home.heroTitle: Plan, sell, and run every event from one dashboard.
home.heroBody: VibeCrafters brings organizers, vendors, and attendees onto a single platform — booking, payments, QR check-in, and live analytics, without the spreadsheets.
home.value1Body: Every ticket ships with a QR e-ticket — no printing, no lines at the door.
home.value2Body: Organizers, vendors, and attendees each get a dashboard built for their job.
home.value3Title: Sales you can see in real time
home.value3Body: Revenue, attendance, and feedback update live as your event runs.

about.title: We craft the vibe, so you can focus on the moment.
about.body: VibeCrafters started as a small event design studio and grew into a full platform — because every organizer we worked with was drowning in spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads, and printed guest lists. We built the tool we wished we'd had.
about.value1Body: Every event we touch gets the same curatorial eye as our brand.
about.value2Body: Organizers, vendors, and attendees all get a dashboard built for them.
about.value3Body: Secure payments, verified vendors, and transparent reporting.
about.value4Body: From draft to sold-out, in a fraction of the usual setup time.
